scripts.build:dev: npm run typecheck:baseline && vite build --mode development
scripts.contexto:regras: python3 scripts/regras_negocio/generate.py --repo . --out docs/contexto/regras --profile regras --schema-snapshot docs/contexto/supabase --index-path docs/contexto/00-INDEX.md --no-pointer
scripts.test:e2e: rm -rf e2e-artifacts playwright-report && npx playwright test --grep-invert '@smoke|@header-sticky'
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e:smoke && npm run test:e2e:header-sticky && npm run test:e2e:regression
scripts.test:e2e:smoke:report: npm run test:e2e:smoke; node scripts/e2e-smoke-summary.mjs; node scripts/e2e-feature-summary.mjs
scripts.test:price-freshness: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; files=( tests/utils/price-freshness*.test.ts tests/components/PriceFreshnessBadge*.test.tsx ); vitest run "${files[@]}" --coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=html --coverage.include=src/utils/price-freshness.ts --coverage.include=src/components/products/PriceFreshnessBadge.tsx --coverage.thresholds.statements=0 --coverage.thresholds.branches=0 --coverage.thresholds.functions=0 --coverage.thresholds.lines=0 && node scripts/check-price-freshness-coverage.mjs'
